text.description_html:
Bommer BB5011-457 4-1/2" x 7" x Square Corners Wide Throw Brass Hinge

Package includes one (1) hinge, matching solid brass flathead, Phillips Drive #12 x 1-1/4" wood screws and 12-24 x 1/2" machine screws.

Fitted with a high grade non-rising, removable, rust resistant, stainless steel button tip hinge pin. Utilizes template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

Specifications: for Bommer BB5011-457 4-1/2" x 7" Wide Throw Brass Hinge

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 7"
  • Corners: Square
  • Dual Ball-Bearing: 2 Ball Bearings
  • Hinge Type: Full Mortise
  • Thickness: 0.134"
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Hinge Pin: Stainless Steel, Removable
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Hinge Material: Solid Brass
  • ANSI A2112
  • Available Finishes: 3
  • Bommer BB5011-457 Dimensional Diagram

This Bommer hinge is special order only, please allow 3-5 weeks for delivery. It is also available in other finishes, Please Contact Us with your requirements.

*Sold Each (1 Door Hinge)
